market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver reaching $120/oz by mid-2026 would require a >2x move beyond its all-time highs (~$50), an unprecedented surge. Historical volatility, current macro trends, and absence of plausible catalysts make a >$120 settlement extremely improbable (<0.5% chance). The market's 6.6% implied probability dramatically overstates the risk, making 'No' the cheap side.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time high is ~$50 (1980/2011); $120 would be an outlier beyond historical extremes.
CME active month silver futures currently trade around $30–$35, requiring a >3x rally in under ~1.5 years.
Even in high inflation scenarios (e.g., 2020–2021), silver only briefly touched $30, showing resistance at higher levels.
The resolution mechanism relies on daily settlement prices, not intraday spikes, increasing the hurdle for a sustained extreme.
